notes.title: New Year's Update 1.2.3
notes.notes:
Happy Christmas and happy New Year Everyone!

We got for you a snowy update with new cosmetics!
Wanna thanks all of you once again for the wonderful start of the game, this year we released in early access for the larger audience the game and most importantly, bring the ability for custom track editing!

We heard a looooot of feedbacks from you guys and we will continue to improve the game further!
I think the next year will bring much more stuff to live and I hope the game will find more people to play, as we believe it's got a huge potential for sure.

So Happy New year guys 😎

notes.title: Update 1.2.2 Keyboard bindings and Quick game update
notes.notes:
Added keybindings for keyboard and mouse. Now you can select button for shooting on both mouse buttons or experiment with other loadouts!
 Updated quick game settings, now it only connects to a lobbies with less than 300ms or will create a new one.
 Added option to show only downloaded tracks in steamworkshop.
 Now the steamworkshop tracks are sorted in most popular this week by default. Added option for sorting by most popular week or the whole time.

notes.title: Update 1.2.1 - Bugfixes & Quick game improvements
notes.notes:
Fixed incorrect official tracks in Quick game (several same tracks)

Competitive mode

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40435172/9c0cc19f38ccef42d528d23498813995a84dc342.png

notes.title: Update 1.1.2 Hotfix
notes.notes:
Track editor and Steam workshop



 Added track scroll on buttons A, D. 
 Changed default in-game volume for custom tracks. 
 Added difficulties for user tracks. New sorting based on difficulties. 
 Added a new tab “Player's choice” near a steam workshop.
 Added new search in track name or author name. 


The new tab Player’s Choice contains hand picked items from all steam workshop files. It is the maps that we choose with correct bpm, timing and not auto generated marker maps. For now, we are checking all the tracks (not all the time) and will pick new items for the collection. Most voted items will get to the Player’s Choice!

Now you can add difficulty to your tracks. You can update existing item difficulty on the Update Track Info page in the track editor or directly in the workshop.

Added track editor customization

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40435172/a593974f77d96a1738749d329806222fb64b4188.png

Now you can add your image for track editor background and change color and opacity for it. This feature requires a DLC Supporter pack. 

Localisation update

 Updated German localization by @shadez.
 Huuuuge update on Ukrainian localization by @pavdam and @Rootovich. Thank you so much guys!


Bugfixes

 Fixed endless “New track starts!” interface
 Fixed wrong image in the track preview.
 Fixed playing song on leaving practice.
 Fixed incorrect negative experience in level progression.
 Fixed wrong scope arrow.
 Fixed possible crash on adding new tracks; crashes in track editor; crash on saving track in custom track selection.


If you will still experience crashes in track editor or on custom tracks in-game - let us know! The fastest way is to write to us in our Discord.

notes.title: Update 1.1.1 Hotfix
notes.notes:
Steam Workshop

 Added possibility to vote for tracks in game. Vote for your favorite tracks!^-^

Custom Track Editor

Find Game

 Now Friends servers are placed on top of the list and it shows only YOUR friends servers.


Localization update


 Korean localization fixes by 삼복구타권법.

Since the Custom Track Editor is a massive feature of the game, we still have tons of bugs and crashes to fix and major improvements to implement. We will manage with them as soon as possible, trying to fix especially crucial things and easy to fix in the first place.
Suggest your ideas in our Discord!

notes.title: Update 1.1.0 Custom track update
notes.notes:
Update 1.1.0

Custom track update

 Added in-game track editor.
 Added steam workshop integration for users tracks.
 Added separate lobbies for official and custom tracks.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40435172/e080b1b2e43c29088f961853d18afa0b99d7835a.png

Before you go and map some memes, we prepared the guide for using the Track Editor. Here it is https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3033919371&preview=true
И версия на русском https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3034173797&preview=true

And a quick notice. It is the first iteration outside our closed tests, so the track editor could have bugs and errors.
We created new channels
#track-editor-suggestions for all things related to the track editor and track sharing
#track-editor-chat and for general chatting about track editor

Localization update

Added 6 new languages to the game - Japanese, Ukrainian, Korean, Portuguese, Chinese Simplified and Chinese Traditional

It’s automatically translated from english with Deep L. Since we don’t have resources right now to translate and correct all the errors, but we really want to make the experience better for players in their native language, we translated the text automatically. 

We will update texts with professional translators later when we are able to, but you can comment on the localization document and we will update text in the game! And we will add your nickname to the titles. https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1gVpQsYlcbPFgM-9oWZe_Pct2tuHJ6jnRd1Try7rJP7g/edit?usp=sharing

notes.title: Update 1.0.6
notes.notes:
New streak system:


 Streak now will multiply damage. 
 Now the streak increases by every shot in marker and ability usage, not only by hitting the enemies. 
 The streak will divide by 2 on death.
 Now you can miss 2 shots in rhythm every 10 streak points and after that you will lose the streak.


With this update, we want to increase musicality and encourage players who are not spamming buttons and follow the rhythm. 

New track

 New track by Ijenta — “Closer pt.2”.
 Updated track “Closer pt.1” with new marker map and sound!
